en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Nuaym Bin Ibrahim, from Misma’a Bin Abdul Malik, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘A (slave) mother of the child, her crimes regarding the rights of the people are upon her master, and whatever was from the Rights of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic regarding the legal penalties (Hadd), so that would be upon her body; and there would be retaliation from it for the slaves, and there would be no retaliation between the free and the slave’.
